user.title: Entertainment Releases
user.description: Connect to TMDB to retrieve movie and TV release information.

data_description.api_token: Your TMDB API Read Access Token (Bearer token).
data_description.region: Two-letter country code used for release information, such as US.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to TMDB. Check your token.

init.title: Entertainment Releases Settings
init.description: Configure release windows, movie relevance, streaming services, TV genres, and refresh frequency.

data_description.theatrical_days: Future theatrical release window, including today. Minimum 1, maximum 30.
data_description.digital_days: Future first-digital-release window, including today. Minimum 1, maximum 30.
data_description.tv_days: TV air-date window, including today. Minimum 1, maximum 30.
data_description.refresh_interval: How often the integration requests updated TMDB data. Minimum 1 hour, maximum 24 hours.
data_description.movie_language: ISO 639-1 original-language code. Use en for English.
data_description.movie_min_score: Filters already-released theatrical titles below this TMDB user score. Future unrated releases are retained.
data_description.tv_language: ISO 639-1 original-language code. Use en for English.
data_description.tv_providers: Shows may be on any selected service. Provider matching uses OR logic and subscription availability.
data_description.tv_genres: Shows may match any selected genre. Genre matching uses OR logic. Leave empty for all scripted/miniseries genres.
